This '''skirmish''' took place in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], during the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]] at the [[Grand Event Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]], their daughter, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], granddaughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]], and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Natua Wan]] and [[Radd Minker]] attended the show a few days into its running. After ditching the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] as they entered the Dangerous Animals level, the group was viewing the animals when the Solo women felt a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

They found that Wan was missing, and the lights in the area suddenly went out. Wan, who had become afflicted with the same [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] that had overcome [[Valin Horn]], [[Seff Hellin]], and Horn's sister [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]]&mdash;a psychosis that caused the affected being to believe that every un-afflicted being they knew had been replaced by an impostor&mdash;hoped to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the "impostors" and cover her escape by releasing the animals present from their cages. Leia was forced to kill all five boarwolves to save a young boy who had fallen into their pen, before the mother nexu had clamped down on an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian's]] leg. Organa Solo stabbed the beast just as the ramps stopped retracting.

While pandemonium flooded the facility, Jaina Solo began a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber duel]] with Wan, who was emptying a [[Bordok/Legends|bordok]] cage. Organa Solo and Minker soon joined in the fight, with Minker ending it with a head-butt which left Wan unconscious. Wan was taken into custody in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]], but increased [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] pressure on the Jedi to turn their captive psychotic Knights over to the government led to the Knights being [[Skirmish at the Krabbis Inn|evacuated]] from the Temple and taken off-world to [[Shedu Maad]].
